name: Foreign Exchange Trade Confirmation Request V 02
definition: Scope| The ForeignExchangeTradeConfirmationRequest message is sent from a market participant to a Central matching utility (CMU) to request a foreign exchange(spot/forward/swap) trade confirmation.||Usage|The confirmation request is sent by the market participants to the CMU after they receiving the capture reports.|Note that a confirmation request could be cancelled or amended.

TradeDetail.name: Trade Detail
TradeDetail.definition: Details of the treasury trade confirmed.

ConfirmationType.name: Confirmation Type
ConfirmationType.definition: Identifies the type of confirmation message being sent.

QueryTradeStatus.name: Query Trade Status
QueryTradeStatus.definition: Specifies the inquiry status of the trade.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
